chat.emptyBody: What you write stays on your computer.
chat.emptyBodyNetwork: Nothing is sent on the network, let alone on the Internet.
chat.notIndexedYet: Please analyze your documents before asking a question.
chat.disclaimer: Administrative assistance. Always check the answer: the practitioner remains the sole decision maker. Nothing is sent automatically.

workFolder.title: Work folder
workFolder.description: The only folder this software may write into. Choose a dedicated folder, not the whole of your documents, and not a folder copied to a cloud service.
workFolder.suggestionWhy: It sits outside your Documents on purpose, so that nothing is copied to OneDrive or iCloud.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: The interface, the messages and the language the answers are written in.
settings.serverUrlDescription: The practice AI. Never a public service.
settings.modelAliasDescription: Which profile answers. The list comes from the AI.
settings.modelAliasUnavailable: The AI has not listed its profiles yet.

errors.batch_too_large: Too many passages were sent at once ({count} for a limit of {limit}). The folder is indexed in smaller batches.
errors.chat_cancelled: The question was stopped before any answer.
errors.context_too_large: This question is too long for one request ({chars} characters for a limit of {limit}). Shorten it.
errors.extraction_empty: This file has no readable text ({path}).
errors.extraction_failed: This file could not be read ({path}).
errors.index_unavailable: The local index could not be opened. Try again; if it persists, restart the application.
errors.insufficient_evidence: No information in your documents answers this question.
errors.internal_error: The AI ran into an unexpected problem. Try again; if it persists, note the time and report it.
errors.no_work_folder_set: Choose a work folder before asking a question about your documents.
errors.invalid_request: The AI refused the request because it was malformed. Please report it.
errors.model_alias_not_allowed: The profile {requested} is not offered by this AI. Choose another one in the settings.
errors.ocr_failed: This page could not be read by recognition ({path}, page {page}).
errors.ocr_language_unavailable: Text recognition does not support the language {locale} yet.
errors.ocr_page_unreadable: This page has no text recognition could keep.
errors.ocr_unavailable: Text recognition is not available. Scanned pages are reported as unreadable until it is fixed.
errors.output_locale_not_supported: This software cannot yet answer in the language {requested}.
errors.provider_capability_unsupported: The AI cannot do this yet ({capability}).
errors.provider_error: The model did not answer correctly. Try again.
errors.provider_unreachable: The AI is running but its model is not answering. Warn whoever looks after the machine.
errors.server_error: The AI replied with an error (code {status}).
errors.server_response_invalid: The AI reply could not be read.
errors.server_timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.server_unreachable: No answer from the AI at {url}. Check that the machine is on and on the same network.
errors.server_url_invalid: This AI address cannot be used ({url}). It must start with http:// or https://.
errors.settings_read_failed: Your settings could not be read, so the default ones are in use.
errors.settings_write_failed: Your settings could not be saved.
errors.work_folder_is_cloud_synced: This folder is copied to {service} ({path}). Professional documents must not leave the practice, so choose a folder outside it, for example directly in your user folder.
errors.work_folder_is_drive_root: A whole disk cannot be the work folder ({path}). Choose a folder inside it.
errors.work_folder_is_protected: This folder is protected, or it holds all of your personal files ({path}). Choose a dedicated subfolder.
errors.work_folder_no_longer_allowed: Your work folder no longer meets the safety rules, most often because a cloud service now copies it. Choose it again.
errors.work_folder_is_symlink: This folder is a shortcut to somewhere else ({path}). Choose the real folder.
errors.work_folder_not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_not_writable: This software cannot write into this folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_unc_not_supported: A network folder cannot be the work folder yet ({path}).
